# DH-ADOM Conformance & Validation Suite

The suite validates whether an implementation conforms to the normative specification.

## Levels

- Level 0: Structural
- Level 1: Declarative
- Level 2: Behavioral
- Level 3: End-to-end
- Level 4: Security / adversarial

The suite does not certify an implementation automatically. It produces evidence that must be reviewed against the specification.
